title: LinkedIn Says Users Love Its Anti-AI-Slop Button
summary: Whatever social media platform you look at, it's increasingly seeming practically impossible to avoid AI-generated content entirely. In recent months, we've seen many platforms roll out tools to help users weed out the slop from the authentic content.
